Tex-Mex in Heart of Ho Chi Minh
Nov 2019 • Friends
Came here with a group of friends (6 in total). Luckily we booked a table as it is quite a small establishment. 
We were greated at the door and then shown to our table where we were handed an extensive menu.

The menu didn’t disappoint with a lot of options including vegan & vegetarian dishes this restaurant seems to cater for all. 
They also had a good cocktail list and the cocktails were really nice. 

Our group had traditional nachos to start, jalopeno balls, and buffalo chicken fingers. 
And then everyone had something different for their mains, including chimichangas, tacos, burrito, mac and cheese, and enchiladas. 

Please keep in mind the portion sizes are huge!! But they do let you take the food away. 

The manager is American himself, and he comes over and greats every table which we liked to see, very good hospitality and makes customers feel like they are very important. 

However it was awkward a couple of times as I’m assuming one of the waiters was new on and he kept being told off in the middle of the restaurant, so that did make us feel uncomfortable at times, as well as the manager pulling him into a back room however we could see through a glass window that he was being told off. 

However all in all it was a great night with friends! Would recommend to anyone craving some home comfort food with decent portion sizes and plenty of flavour.

You usually know something is wrong when you walk into a "Mexican" restaurant and the music is from all over the Latin American map. I should have walked out then. Have you ever had tortilla chips in a Mexican restaurant? Of course, you have. Here you get six chips, no more, with some lousy pico de gallo and a bottle of ketchup. I ordered the sopa de pollo. Funny thing about soup - you have to prepare it ahead of time and let it simmer. Here the soup was served in a shallow, white bowl, cold, flavorless, unimaginative, with some soggy bread-like things and day-old coriander floating lifelessly on top.
